title: MOSS-Audio-8B-Thinking
summary: An open-source audio foundation model designed for complex audio reasoning and timestamped transcription using Chain-of-Thought capabilities. It leverages a Qwen3-8B backbone and cross-layer feature injection to maintain high-fidelity acoustic details.
research_notes: Achieves state-of-the-art performance in audio reasoning benchmarks, outperforming much larger models like Step-Audio-R1 33B.

evolution.summary: After the initial MOSS-Audio release in April 2026, the team expanded the family with MOSS-Music-8B in May 2026 for specialized music QA. The project has since added full support for SGLang serving and comprehensive LoRA fine-tuning workflows.
